record.question: What is the permissible noise level in residential areas during daytime in India?
record.explanation: Answer C: 55 dB. India’s Noise Pollution Rules set 55 dB(A) Leq as the daytime residential-area limit. Reference: https://cpcb.nic.in/noise-pollution/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
